$note.basicFreeUpgrades: Free upgrades a Basic card gets; other cards get one per rank.
$note.aboveVisibleRank: Upgrade slots a card has beyond the rank its face shows.
$note.stonesAfterFree: Smithing Stones each upgrade costs once the free ones are used.

$note.cantripTag: A card with this tag, or an upgrade step adding it, is always Basic.
$note.spellTags: A card with any of these tags is never Basic unless it is a cantrip.
$note.rarity: The rarity a non-spell card needs to be Basic.

$note.maxCandidates: Most rolled steps an offer searches for distinct options.
$note.blacksmithFewerChoicesChance: Chance a Blacksmith offers the fewer choices instead of the more.
$note.basicChoicesWithoutRun: Choices on a Basic card when there is no run to roll from.
$note.rankedChoicesWithoutRun: Choices on a ranked card when there is no run to roll from.

$note.singleOptionUpTo: Upgrades up to this number offer one single-effect option at a rest site.
$note.laterChoices: Options offered for later upgrades, each of which may carry two effects.
$note.twoEffectChance: Chance an option gets a second effect of another family.

$note.fallback: The family an authored upgrade claims when no other family matches.
$note.opsByFamily: The effect ops each family reads when it judges an authored upgrade.

refusals.missing: That card is not in the deck.
refusals.slots: {name} has {slots} upgrade {slotWord} (rank + 1); raise its rank for more.

$note.slots: {slotWord} is slotWord for one slot, else slotsWord.

$note.classes: Classes a card's neutral score reference may use as its own.
$note.magicClass: Reference class for a classless spell or non-physical card.
$note.martialClass: Reference class for any other classless card.
$note.seed: Seed of the neutral reference run.
